stemMd: A recessive trait is X-linked. An unaffected woman known to carry the allele has children with an unaffected man. Among their sons, what fraction is expected to have the trait?
explanationMd: A son receives his Y chromosome from his father and his single X chromosome from his mother. The carrier mother transmits either X with equal probability. Half of sons therefore inherit the recessive allele and express it; the question conditions on already being a son.

distractorRationale.b: One quarter applies to all children if sexes are equally likely, not to sons alone.
distractorRationale.d: This does not follow from the mother having one affected and one unaffected X chromosome.
distractorRationale.a: A son may inherit the affected X chromosome from his mother.
distractorRationale.e: The mother can also pass on her unaffected X chromosome.
